TITLE: UPI Service
INTRO_1: Easy and quick payment transactions using Unified Payments Interface (UPI) with MPSS Bank. Unified Payments Interface 2.0 is a real-time interbank payment system that allows sending or requesting money.
INTRO_2: Any UPI client app may be used and multiple bank accounts may be linked to a single app.
METHODS_TITLE: Unified Payments Interface allows transactions using the following methods:
VPA: Virtual Payment Address (VPA) or UPI ID: Send or request money from/to bank account mapped using VPA.
MOBILE: Mobile number: Send or request money from/to the bank account mapped with mobile number.
ACCOUNT_IFSC: Account number & IFSC: Send money directly to the bank account.
QR: QR code: Send money using QR code containing VPA, Account number & IFSC or Mobile number.
MOBILE_LINKED: Mobile number should be linked with bank account
